name: OrderFlow Cookie Consent
author: muhammadaamir10

sections.description:
OrderFlow Cookie Consent is a lightweight, fully customizable GDPR cookie consent plugin for WordPress. Add a beautiful cookie consent banner to your site in minutes — no coding required.

Trusted by site owners across EU, UK, and worldwide to comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws.

Features

  • Beautiful cookie consent banner
  • Top or bottom position
  • Popup style (bottom-left or bottom-right)
  • Custom background, text and button colors
  • Accept and Decline buttons
  • Privacy Policy link
  • Cookie expiry control
  • Slide or fade animation
  • Mobile responsive
  • Lightweight — no page speed impact
  • No tracking — plugin sets no tracking cookies itself

Why Choose OrderFlow Cookie Consent?

Unlike bloated cookie plugins, OrderFlow Cookie Consent is simple, fast, and gets the job done. No unnecessary features, no performance impact.

Legal Compliance

This plugin helps you display a cookie consent notice as required by GDPR, CCPA, and similar regulations. You are responsible for ensuring your site’s full legal compliance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via Plugins menu
  3. Go to Cookie Consent in your dashboard
  4. Customize your banner and save
  5. Visit your site to see the cookie banner!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. It shows a consent banner and remembers the user’s choice. You are responsible for ensuring your site uses cookies correctly.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is extremely lightweight.

How long is consent stored?

You can configure the expiry in settings (default 365 days).

Can visitors decline cookies?

Yes. Enable the Decline button in settings.
